The center panel displays a ventral view of a chiton, revealing the broad muscular foot and the arrangement of the girdle/plates from below. The right panel features a bright yellow, elongated object (possibly a fruit like a kiwi or a stylized biological illustration) next to a white, porous, coral-like structure.
